item.title: Pilot strike at Lufthansa cancels flights to and from Copenhagen
item.description: Most of Lufthansa’s flights to and from Copenhagen Airport will be canceled on Thursday and Friday because of a pilot strike. According to the airport’s website, seven out of nine departures on both days are canceled. The same applies to arrivals. The cancellations affect flights to and from Munich and Frankfurt in Germany. item.title: What Denmark can’t see about its own creative talent
item.description: Some of the most discouraging experiences when you try to build a career in Denmark come from the system’s apparent difficulty recognizing talent that doesn’t arrive in familiar packaging.

item.title: Social Democrat Minister: The Liberal Party is blocking drinking water protection
item.description: Environment Minister Magnus Heunicke (Social Democrats) has accused coalition partner Venstre (The Liberal Party) of obstructing efforts to protect Denmark’s drinking water. item.title: Nature agency: Kids under ten shouldn’t go alone in wolf areas
item.description: Danish authorities advise that children under ten should not be alone in areas with wolves. Officials warn that some wolves have lost their instinctive shyness, likely due to feeding, which is considered dangerous. item.title: Denmark lacks plasma donors to be self-sufficient
item.description: Denmark needs approximately 20,000 new plasma donors to become self-sufficient, as domestic donors covered only 49% of the demand in 2024. Currently, Denmark must purchase plasma from abroad, such as the USA. Plasma is used for medicine, primarily immunoglobulin, and for patients with major blood loss.
